hooks.command: sh -c 'if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "$0"; fi; exec sh "${0%/*}/reef-nopython.sh" bash' "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/reef-guard.py"
sh -c 'command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec python3 "$0"; echo "reef-guard: python3 is required to check a dispatch — denied" >&2; exit 2' "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/reef-guard.py"
sh -c 'command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec python3 "$0"; exec sh "${0%/*}/reef-nopython.sh" edit' "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/reef-guard.py"
sh -c 'command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec python3 "$0"; exec sh "${0%/*}/reef-nopython.sh" approval' "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/reef-approval.py"
sh -c 'command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; [ -f .reef/config.json ] && [ -f scripts/reef-loop.py ] || exit 0; exec python3 scripts/reef-loop.py tick --session-start --hook'
